insights.one_liner: Swapfiets is the Amsterdam bike-subscription company owned by Pon, with 280,000+ members across Europe; still loss-making and not a visa sponsor.

culture.text: A B Corp offering bikes and e-bikes by monthly subscription, with about 591 employees and HQ in Amsterdam.
Staff often come from University of Amsterdam, VU, TU Delft and Groningen, in economics, business and psychology.
Most people work in operations, sales, engineering and IT.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, a senior software engineering role in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch.
Operates in eight countries including Germany, France, Spain and the UK.

growth.text: Halved its multi-million loss, but owner Pon again had to step in financially.
Founded in 2014 and grew to over 280,000 members across Europe.

worth_knowing.text: Union FNV criticised Swapfiets' collective labour agreement offer as not covering inflation.
Still makes a loss, though it is recovering more stolen bikes.
